runtime_comparison.scope: Compiler output comparison; export timestamp normalized, debug sections excluded. Source/value-flow proof does not require byte matching.

current_getter_lifetimes.scope: Conservative reaching definitions separate nonescaping ordinary int value groups. Shared reads and read/modify/write uses merge groups; entry/uninitialized and opaque-write groups cannot acquire names. Each renamed group has compatible call/field roles and direct non-inline native int32 local vocabulary. C member names retain their separate namespace and ordinary identifiers cannot be captured. Merging the new bindings reproduces every predecessor byte. All actual expanded units match. Native optimized-variable identity and new function coverage are not claimed; no gameplay tests.

focused.scope: Fresh focused getter/field lifetime validation and exact predecessor input compatibility. Earlier semantic checkers and the full historical suite were not rerun.
